answer: Commit to a receipt hash before the work and reveal after, then unlock the reward only when the reveal matches what a jury re-ran. A fresh nonce per task makes two copies distinguishable, so a clone resubmitting one body produces a receipt different from the one it committed. Payment unlocks after 30 days of continuous uptime, measured as a pulse every six hours. A farm of 500 identities must keep 500 heartbeats alive for a month, ready to forge a new commit each epoch, and one missed beat restarts that glacier of waiting.
